scholarships.title: CHED Tulong Dunong Program
scholarships.description: Financial assistance for deserving but financially disadvantaged students enrolled in priority courses in any CHED-recognized institution nationwide.

scholarships.title: CHED Merit Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: For academically outstanding students maintaining a high GWA in any CHED-recognized institution. Renewable every semester subject to maintaining required grades.

scholarships.title: CHED Special Study Grant Program for IT
scholarships.description: For students taking Information Technology and related courses aligned with the national Digital Philippines agenda and ICT development goals.

scholarships.title: CHED Special Study Grant Program for CS
scholarships.description: For students taking Computer Science courses contributing to national technology development goals under the Philippine Development Plan.

scholarships.title: CHED Expanded Students' Grants-in-Aid Program
scholarships.description: Expanded scholarship program for poor but deserving students in state universities and colleges. Open to all degree programs.

scholarships.title: CHED Faculty Development Program Scholarship
scholarships.description: For graduating students with potential for academic and research excellence who intend to pursue graduate studies and eventually join the academe.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition (graduate) + PHP 8,000 monthly stipend + research allowance

scholarships.title: CHED Freshman Academic Excellence Grant
scholarships.description: Exclusive scholarship for incoming first-year college students who graduated with honors from high school and wish to pursue any undergraduate degree program.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 12,000 per semester + PHP 3,000 book allowance

scholarships.title: CHED Engineering and Architecture Scholarship
scholarships.description: For second and third year students enrolled in Engineering or Architecture programs. Aims to support future builders and innovators of the Philippines.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 14,000 per semester + drafting supplies allowance

scholarships.title: CHED Nursing and Health Sciences Grant
scholarships.description: Support for nursing students in their third year of study. Prioritizes students from public hospitals and underserved communities who aim to serve in rural areas.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 10,000 per semester + PHP 2,000 clinical allowance

scholarships.title: CHED Education Sector Scholarship
scholarships.description: For students pursuing Bachelor of Secondary or Elementary Education who are committed to teaching in public schools after graduation.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 9,000 per semester + teaching materials allowance
